thread:
Nora (Partner Ops): FYI partners flagged a regression after the latest driver roll; some marketplace images hitting runtime errors. tagging runtime & platform to triage
Diego (Runtime Eng): saw a few failing jobs in nightly. error appears as `cudaErrorInvalidDeviceFunction` from a fused kernel path when quantized kernels are used
Yuna (HW Partner): we bumped drivers in partner labs to 536.01 last week. what exact driver/cuda/runtime combo are the failing images using?
Diego (Runtime Eng): affected combo: driver=536.01, cuda=12.2, runtime tag `redwood-quant-v2`. repro on GA100 and A10 with certain sequence lengths. minimal repro attached as code block:
```
SEQ=1024
BATCH=1
QT=bitsandbytes
FLAGS="--enable-fused-attn"
./run_infer --seq $SEQ --batch $BATCH --quant $QT --flags "$FLAGS"
```
fails on kernel launch with invalid device function
Asha (Marketplace PM): we have a marketplace launch this week for a partner image. if this is widespread we should pin marketplace images or add a documented toggle. what's conservative mitigation? :thinking_face:
Ben (Platform): short-term: publish a pinned image tag that uses driver 535.43 + cuda 12.1 runtime (we already have a previous tag). also add an env toggle `RW_DISABLE_FUSED=1` so customers can opt out at runtime
Diego (Runtime Eng): alternative runtime patch: catch kernel launch failure and transparently fall back to unfused kernel path; enable via env `RW_FALLBACK_UNFUSED=1`. low-risk, hotfixable, and avoids full image swap for many customers
Yuna (HW Partner): we'll run the repro on 535.43 and on 536.01 with fused toggle disabled. will report perf delta and confirm whether driver introduces function symbol changes
sre-bot: Reminder: create canary route and synthetic tests before switching tags. Templates: latency p50/p95, error-rate, kernel-failure-count
Nora (Partner Ops): action list: 1) Ben push pinned-image tag and canary route (ETA 2h), 2) Diego prepare runtime fallback patch (feature flag) as backup, 3) Yuna validate with partner lab and share logs, 4) Asha hold public partner announcement until green
Asha (Marketplace PM): acknowledged. I'll draft partner comms and a short FAQ about the toggle + expected perf tradeoffs
Ben (Platform): pushing `marketplace-pin-53543-cuda12.1` now, will include env toggles and rollback steps in release notes. CI smoke in progress
Diego (Runtime Eng): I'll prototype fallback try/catch and a small unit test for kernel failure simulation. if we can land this today we can flip the flag for affected SKUs rapidly
Yuna (HW Partner): running tests now, ETA 90m. will post results (logs + perf numbers) back to this thread
Nora (Partner Ops): thanks all — update thread with canary metrics and lab validation. if canary looks good by tomorrow 09:00 PT we proceed with announcement, otherwise postponing. :thumbsup:
